mentions.name: Local-first Kanban Board
mentions.description: A local-first Kanban task board built with Tauri (Rust + Svelte). It stores data in JSON files the user controls, offers a full keyboard-first UX, supports parent/child tasks and release management, and is fast via localStorage with background sync. It includes no telemetry and works purely locally.
mentions.problem: Frustration with SaaS task tools and basic offline options; a perceived gap between "todo.txt" simplicity and Jira complexity.
mentions.audience: Personal task management; the author frames it as a personal task tool.
